domain_ownership.physics: mechanics, thermodynamics, fluids, electromagnetism, relativity, quantum physics, astronomy, astrophysics, cosmology, optics and spacetime physics

domain_ownership.engineering: mechanical, electrical, electronic, control, robotics, mechatronics, materials, manufacturing, aerospace, energy, systems, reliability and experimental engineering
domain_ownership.computing: computer science, AI, scientific computing, computational perception and knowledge management

frontier_truth_policy.quantum_teleportation: established quantum-state protocol; not macroscopic matter teleportation

NIST metrology, uncertainty, engineering and AI/TEVV

truthfulness_note: 941M is the deterministic addressable curriculum space built from 56 themes and 885 canonical concepts. It is not 941M independently researched facts, and it must not be added to the 22.15M legacy factual addressable total as if both were unique factual claims.
